text: The system shall email the customer a decision within 5 minutes of a refund request being approved or rejected.
The finance manager shall approve any refund over 500 within 2 working days.
The system shall approve any refund under 50 automatically.
The system shall record who approved each refund, the time, and the amount.
The team leader shall approve any refund over 400 within 1 working day.
The system shall delete refund records 7 years after the refund is paid.
The system shall keep the approval record for every refund for the life of the client account.
The system shall send the customer a text message when the refund is paid.
The system shall record the reason for each refund.
